title: dactylorhiza carpatica
intro: Dactylorhiza carpatica, commonly known as the Carpathian marsh orchid, is a species of terrestrial orchid that belongs to the Dactylorhiza genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, as it is believed to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza carpatica include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve respiratory function, and exhibit anti-edematous properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
